market_rotation.reader_model: When BTC is weak, prefer relative-strength leaders for watchlists and relative underperformers for conditional downside analysis; do not state that a coin will pump solely because BTC falls.

research_policy: Money flow is inferred from observable proxies, not wallet-level capital tracking.
LONG/SHORT setups require multi-timeframe alignment, flow confirmation, liquidity and model confidence.
Trigger/invalidation/TP are ATR-derived model levels, not guarantees or instructions to execute.
WAIT is a first-class answer whenever evidence conflicts or data is incomplete.
Never claim a coin will pump just because BTC falls; require relative strength and flow evidence.

content_recipe.headline: Lead with the market-regime change or capital-rotation observation, not a generic price move.
content_recipe.body: Explain BTC/ETH/BNB regime, then show the alt that is gaining/losing relative strength and the evidence stack.
content_recipe.setup: Only publish a conditional setup when side is LONG/SHORT and confidence >= 65, liquidity >= 55, and data quality is acceptable.
content_recipe.risk: Always show invalidation and explain what would make the thesis wrong.
content_recipe.monetization: Use only natural, story-relevant cashtags and verified trading widgets. Never manufacture urgency or solicit trades just to generate clicks.
